'''2007 Illinois State Championship Brian Taylor LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Taylor]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ethan Taylor
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
